recipes.name: Chipotle Macaroni and Cheese
ingredients_raw: 1 pound elbow macaroni, cooked according to package directions
1 chipotle pepper from canned chipotles in adobo sauce, or more to taste
0.5 teaspoon Spice Islands® Fine Grind Black Pepper
0.25 cup Argo® OR Kingsford's® Corn Starch

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease a 3-quart casserole dish or 13x9-inch pan.

Blend 2 cups half and half, chipotle pepper, bouillon cubes, and garlic in a blender or food processor until well-blended. Pour into a large saucepan; add onion powder, black pepper, remaining 2 cups of half and half, and corn starch. Stirring constantly, bring to a boil; boil and stir until very thick, about 1 minute. Remove from heat.
Gradually stir in cheeses until melted. Add cooked pasta and stir until blended. Pour mixture into the prepared dish and sprinkle with desired topping.
Bake until browned and bubbly around edges, 25 to 30 minutes.

raw_recipe.headline: Chipotle Macaroni and Cheese
raw_recipe.description: Creamy chipotle mac and cheese gets a spicy kick with the addition of chipotle peppers and pepper Jack cheese.

review.reviewBody: Amazing. Added a bit more Chipotle peppers just for kicks and it turned out to be the perfect amount of spice! Also added some green bell peppers, onion tomato and bread crumbs on top right before baking to give some more diversity to it. Came out perfect. Thanks for the great recipe. My new go to mac and cheese!

This is how macaroni and cheese should always be!!! So delicious! I can’t eat the plain stuff anymore, haha! I did the 1/2 monterey jack, 1/2 pepperjack but had to add 1 more chile and LOTS of spicy adobo sauce to the cheese mixture in order to taste the heat. I think next time I will probably try all pepperjack cheese and 2-3 chiles total. I took the suggestion of others and fried a pound of bacon to “crumble” on top, then added a layer of breadcrumbs and then sprinkled smoked paprika on top of that. Soooooo good!! It is rich and decadent, smokey, spicy, warm and stick-to-your-ribs good!! I might try adding chicken next time as some others have done for a complete meal. And it will definitely be going on my Thanksgiving menu for next year!!!

Awesome recipe! I altered it a bit to serve for a party so it's not spicy for everyone! Instead of Chicken bouillon cubes I used 1 pk of Ramen Noodles seasoning for creamy chicken + 3/4 cup of chicken broth (it was what I had in stock). I used regular sharp cheddar cheese blocks (2) along with 1/2 pack of shredded sharp cheddar cheese. Once I cooked and drained my noodles I put them in a pan and sprinkled about 3 tsp of light salt and added 3 raw eggs (scrambled) to the noodles. In small pot I did my cheese mixture with half & half, 2 blocks of sharp cheddar cheese cut up, chicken seasoning packet I mentioned above & chicken broth, 3 tbsp of corn starch (Cream brand was what I had in stock), 2 tsp of red pepper on low heat until it formed a thick mixture. Then poured over the noodles, mixed it well then I and added chives and 2 cups of shredded cheese. Then you just add light salt or salt to your liking! Topped with remaining shredded cheese and paprika. LOVED IT!

So I went to a smoke-out challenge with the top brisket,pulled pork, etc smoker masters in the world and one of the vendors was selling chipotle Mac and cheese (odd) and I have been trying to recreate it ever since. Let me first say that I have made this more than a few times - as the recipe is stated it is delicious. 5 stars. If you are like me and like heat, I will tell you that even adding 2 chipotle peppers to the recipe rather than 1 didn’t even get a comment from my 7 year old who complains if something had too much pepper even. Kids love it and it’s great. If you really want to spice it up - use three Chiles and a pinch of cayenne Into the sauce before adding the cheese(only takes a pinch) and then finish it off in the smoker rather than the oven. You will be in for an unbelievable treat and never would you have thought anyone would compliment Mac and cheese so much. Killer recipe killer Mac thank you for sharing it

This is a very good dish! Cheesy and creamy with a nice kick, but not too spicy at the same time. I have made this a few times using 3 chipotle peppers as well as adding about a generous tablespoon of the adobo sauce. I have also added a 10oz can of shredded chicken to give it some meat so it could pass as a dinner. I stirred in the chicken right before it went in the baking dish and it turned out great!

I only used 4 of the 5 suggested boullion cubes, and it was still overwhelmingly salty. The flavor overpowered the chipotle. Next time I'd only use 2 cubes. Also, they tore up my food processor - I would add them straight to the cream mixture on the stove rather than blending. Chipotle is of course to taste, but if it's a flavor you enjoy I'd do at least two.

This stuff is addictive. My husband and I can eat a whole 9x13 pan in 24 hours. If you want to avoid gaining 10 lbs every time you make this, you may want to make a smaller batch as a side dish or invite guests to come help you eat it. We like spicy food, so we double the chipotle, and we add a pound of crumbled bacon. I also recommend having everything prepped before you start, because once you get into making the sauce, you don't have time to stop and measure ingredients.

I adapted the recipe to lower fat and had some lobster that I wanted to add to it. I used fat free half and half, chipotle powder instead of the pepper and half of the cheese was reduced fat cheddar and the other half, havarti (to give that rich buttery feel). For the chicken base I substituted Lobster base. Made these into appy style small plates and topped each small plate with 1 tablespoon of the pepper jack cheese before baking. Grumpy LOVED it. Very creamy and awesome flavor from the lobster base! The little bites of lobster in the dish just made it even more yummy! I feel the original recipe without changes would be high on my list also!

I adjusted to 3 servings and baked in a glass bowl. I mostly followed as is except for using 2c. penne, 1.5 chipotles and an extra garlic clove. I forgot to divide the half & half and used it all in the first step, so for the second I added 3 tsp. heavy whipping cream. I tried paprika/chipotle powder and pepperjack on top but honestly I preferred the sauce alone. The sauce was creamy and delicious, there was plenty but I wouldn't mind a little extra. I can't imagine making the original serving size, the 3-serving made 4 bowlfuls.

I made it exactly as the recipe indicated, with the exception that I increased each cheese by about 1/2. I used only one chipotle pepper and that was sufficient to give the dish a good zing. It was bordering on being too salty - next time I won't salt the noodles before cooking them. Definitely a keeper

I've been searching for a good homemade mac n cheese recipe, most haven't been quite good enough. This one may make it into the final round. One chipotle pepper is definitely not enough, I used 2 and would probably use another if I make it again. When mixing the half and half, peppers, bouillon and garlic, I processed for awhile, let it sit for a couple minutes so the bouillon could dissolve a little bit and then finished processing. Also, on top I used breadcrumbs instead of cheese or paprika. Next time I may mix breadcrumbs, a little parmesan cheese and a smidge of paprika. Pretty good mac n cheese!
Love this recipe! It's always a crowd pleaser. Nice and cheesy

This did well with 100% pepper jack (didn't wanna buy monterey for just one dish). Wife thought the heat was just right (don't tell her I doubled the chipotle). Leftovers paired really well with skillet fried Polish sausage.
I followed the recipe exactly and it was wonderful!! Just spicy enough without being overpowering. I will make this again!

Some of my family cannot do a lot of spice so I substituted the chipotle peppers with Mrs Dash Southwest Chipotle seasoning blend. The whole bottle. It adds amazing flavor and smokiness. It’s a friend and family favorite!! I even catered a wedding of 200 with this recipe. Not a noodle was left!!!
Pretty much an ideal side dish for some nice bbq brisket
My family loved it!
No changes made but I will add additional chipotle peppers next time as my children wanted it spicier.
It’s Hatch pepper time!
One of our favorites, what a great twist on Mac and cheese!
